title: Question 24
passage:
Could you hold the umbrella while I fold the stroller?
A. It folds flat enough to fit in the trunk. B. I left the umbrella stand by the door. C. Sure. I’ll keep it over you.
passageZh:
我收嬰兒車時，你能幫我撐一下傘嗎？
A. 它折平後放得進後車廂。 B. 我把傘架放在門邊了。 C. 好，我會把傘撐在你上方。
